result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both sheets list all ten signals with exactly the supplied meanings and fit cleanly on one page. A's grouping boxes repeat the answers below the table, but they sit apart from it. B's 'Memory Cue' column paraphrases each meaning right next to it, so covering the Meaning column still gives the answers away and adds extra wording to learn. Neither sheet supports testing meaning to signal, but A works better as a self-test. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers list all ten signals with the exact meanings supplied. A's 'Memory Cue' column sits right next to the meanings and paraphrases them, so covering the Meaning column still gives the answers away. B gives a clear cover-and-recall instruction and offers a notes column, though its grouping boxes repeat shortened meanings (for example 'Backup', 'Medical') below the table, which also leaks the answers and adds some extra material.
